decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 4 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 18 entered turn 4, rode the kerb which created understeer, taking his car into the side of Car 23. Despite this being a lap 1 incident, the collision was not the result of normal lap 1 crowding, so the usual tolerance for lap 1 instances is not applicable.
fact: Car 18 caused a collision with Car 23 in turn 4.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
